name: Prized

plans.name: Paid credit plan
plans.note: $10–$1,000/month standard ladder, with exact fleet-sized plans above $1,000. The whole payment lands as usage credit; unused paid credit rolls over only up to two months of the plan. Overage is off by default; $10–$250 one-time top-ups are separate.

caveats: Plan is prepaid credit ($10–$1000 plus custom fleet-sized rungs), not an extra fee. Credit rollover capped at two months; long cycles receive proportional extra credit.
Exact awake rate is monthly size price/730; visible hourly numbers are rounded. Monthly size cap is explicitly documented.

Sleep charges the entire retained allocated disk at $0.0001/GB-hour; included running disk is NOT free while paused. Engine storage model cannot switch full-disk billing on only during sleep; worked example adds it manually.
Free $30 is once; trial permits 1 box, no auto-pause, max Small, and pauses workspace after >30 minutes full-CPU saturation. Paid workspace max 100 boxes.
Nano/Micro are burstable EC2 t3a; larger m6a VMs. No GPU/arm64/nested KVM. Only workspace-authenticated shared URLs; not public web hosting.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

Re-checked 2026-09-28: prized.dev/docs/billing, /docs/limits, /docs/snapshots, /pricing and llms.txt publish no egress/bandwidth price and no snapshot storage price (snapshots capped at 20 manual/template per workspace, auto-snapshots keep 1-10). egress_gib and snapshot_gib_month stay null (unknown, not free).

fleet.verification: Onboarding grants credit without card; paid credit plan afterwards.
fleet.tiers: Introductory credit allows 1 retained box; paid workspace permits 100 nondeleted boxes.
fleet.notes: All boxes count, including paused/deep-sleep; this is stricter than a running-only cap. 10/50 supported once paid, but no published increase path beyond 100 for 300/1,000. Larger custom-dollar plan does not by itself prove a higher box limit.
fleet.balance_gate: Enough balance to run the resulting whole fleet for four hours is required to create, wake or resize; it is a check, not a charge.
fleet.request_rate: 20 requests/second sustained, burst 40, per token and per box; 8 concurrent requests per token and per box.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.quote: Memory snapshot (hibernate). Processes, tmux sessions, and half-finished builds resume where they were.
snapshot_auto.note: Trigger: any pause, incl. auto-pause after idle window (30 min-7 days, paid plans only), pause deadline (--ttl) and nightly quiet hours. Memory included only on Nano/Micro/Extra Small/Small (EC2 hibernate); Medium and larger 'Clean stop' (disk persists, processes restart). After 14 days paused the disk is parked as a snapshot ('deep sleep'). Separately, per-box scheduled automatic disk snapshots (`prized box auto-snapshot --every 6h --keep 5`) exist; those are scheduled backups, not stop-triggered.

snapshot_on_demand.quote: A snapshot is an image of the box's whole disk at one instant, taken while the box keeps running; the box is never paused for it.
snapshot_on_demand.note: Disk only, crash-consistent ('anything still in memory ... is not in it'); block-level incremental. Restore always creates a NEW box; `prized fork` of a running box (minutes); named templates new boxes start from. CLI, dashboard and HTTP API. 20 manual/template snapshots per workspace.

harness_api.quote: Send Claude Code or Codex on your box a prompt from your machine or from any script, follow what it does as it happens, and interrupt it.
harness_api.note: Harnesses: Claude Code (`claude -p`) and Codex (`codex exec`). CLI `prized prompt --provider claude|codex` (model, effort, --auto, --continue resumes session, --queue, --detach), `prized events --follow`, `prized prompt ls`, `prized interrupt`; edge HTTP API: POST /prompts, GET /prompts, GET /prompts/{runId}/events (SSE), POST /prompts/{runId}/interrupt. Normalized JSONL events. POST /prompts wakes a suspended box.

egress_allowlist.note: No egress controls documented; workspace policies cover spend/box limits/auto-pause, not network.

egress_http_rules.note: Only HTTP-level behaviour is the secrets broker (substitutes placeholders for allowlisted hosts; refuses plain HTTP for secret use), which is not a general egress rule engine.

ingress_rules.quote: Public ports: none. A box cannot open a port to the internet. To show a running server to a teammate, share the port: a prized.dev link that opens only for signed-in members of your workspace.
ingress_rules.note: Inbound only the WireGuard tunnel (udp/51820, tcp/443); ports mirrored to your localhost over tunnel; per-port share/unshare to workspace-authenticated links (`prized ports share 3000`). No public URLs possible. No IP allowlists documented.

guest_firewall.note: Dedicated EC2 VM per box ('One virtual machine per box with its own kernel; not a container') with passwordless sudo; iptables/nftables not mentioned in docs.

secret_proxy.quote: Processes on the box see a placeholder, and when one calls an HTTPS host you allowlisted, the box's broker swaps the real value into the request headers on the way out; plain HTTP is refused.
secret_proxy.note: Arbitrary secrets with up to 32 allowlisted hosts each (hostname or *. wildcard); presets (Connectors) for OpenAI, Anthropic, GitHub, Slack, ClickHouse. HTTPS headers only; no DB/SSH/git-protocol coverage. CAVEAT: the broker `prized-secretsd` runs ON the box as root ('Secret values in memory only'), and Security page says 'root on your box can read anything on it' while the login user has passwordless sudo - so the real value does enter the VM's memory; it is not an off-box proxy. Also per-use counts per host are recorded.

volume_attach.quote: One encrypted volume is the root and the only disk: your home directory, Docker images, and the system all live on it.
volume_attach.note: Disk grows only via resize; 'Infinite storage (alpha)' is an opt-in growing storage pool replacing the fixed disk, not an extra volume.

volume_shared.quote: One encrypted volume is the root and the only disk: your home directory, Docker images, and the system all live on it.
volume_shared.note: No shared/network volume between boxes documented. `prized mount` is a local NFS-over-SFTP view of one box on your laptop, not box-to-box.
